Subject: Code challenge brief + timeline (Redwood Inference)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. As discussed, attached is the code challenge brief for the Senior API Engineer role. A few things to note:

- Goal: build a small end-to-end prototype and short writeup showing design tradeoffs (see brief).
- Time budget: we expect ~4–8 hours of work; quality > completeness.
- Deliverables: repo link (GitHub or zip), short README with run instructions, and a 1–2 page design notes PDF.
- Allowed: any language/framework; please document required runtime and any external services.
- Deadline: submit by end of day Monday, 1 June 2026 (23:59 PT). If that creates a conflict, let us know and we can discuss an accommodation.

I've cc'd Mina from Talent to help coordinate logistics. Attachments: redwood-code-challenge-brief.pdf (prompt) and evaluation-rubric.xlsx (what reviewers will use).

Please reply to confirm you received the brief. If you have a quick question about the dataset included in the brief, ping me and I'll clarify.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex —

Good question. The sample_input.csv is included in the Drive folder; link is in the brief (and I've added it here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-sample-input). It's small and synthetic — please don't call any external APIs for it. If you prefer to use a generated mock that matches the schema that's fine, but using the sample provided will make it easier for reviewers to run your solution.

If you'd like a short extension, say to Wednesday 2 June EOD, let me know — no pressure if you can make Monday.
